item.text: [{"task_id":"fe9372f3","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    seed = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    diagonal = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    ray = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    marker = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    radius = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    period = int(round(params['rule'][6]))","    out = grid.copy()","    points = np.argwhere(grid == seed)","    if len(points) == 0 or period <= 0:","        return out","    center = np.mean(points, axis=0)","    cr = int(round(center[0]))","    cc = int(round(center[1]))","    for r in range(grid.shape[0]):","        for c in range(grid.shape[1]):","            if grid[r, c] != bg:","                continue","            dr = abs(r - cr)","            dc = abs(c - cc)","            if dr == dc and dr >= radius:","                out[r, c] = diagonal","            elif r == cr or c == cc:","                distance = max(dr, dc)","                if distance > radius:","                    if (distance - radius) % period == 0:","                        out[r, c] = marker","                    else:","                        out[r, c] = ray","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[7]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,1,8,4,1,3]},"rationale":"Preserve the red cross. From its center, extend blue diagonals and cyan cardinal rays to the grid boundaries. Beyond the cross's unit radius, every third cardinal cell is yellow, at distances 4, 7, 10, and so on.
